snapshot_origin.scope: Separately source-reviewed p112_D edition by the parent collaboration. This snapshot supplies comparison evidence, not a new physical record or a new source claim.

limits: The November1 three-part order and November4 p112_D report have different wording, lengths, references and headers; no same-plaintext retransmission is asserted.
Direct BVG and KOSPOLI in the present records are contextual parallels. They do not replace the literal BVN, BEIBVG or7OSPOLI fields in p112_D.
No numerical relabeling, root source edit or key propagation follows from this comparison.

prior_attribution_check.key_credit: Unchanged published Nov1–3 key with original provenance.

limits: The repeated receiving header, sender/address line, message time, three-part count and consecutive1/2/3 labels establish the cross-page assembly; topic alone is not used.
The reported armistice and passage conditions are statements in an intercepted message, not an independent historical verification.
Raw numeral labels inside ordinary words are repaired only through explicitly listed source-coordinate substitutions. No global numerical map is changed.
All routing abbreviations and references are left literal. GL is displayed as Gl., not silently expanded.
No frame change, insertion, deletion, erasure fill or key change is used in the three primary records.
Earlier repository candidates and published key credit are retained; no historical first-solution claim is made.
